rule0.statement: The Wiseman 2026 acquisition's committed git blobs have drifted from the sha256_manifest.json pins by exactly their line-ending counts (autocrlf clean at commit time); the repair is to restore the PINNED ORIGINAL BYTES into the blobs (route a) for every file whose original bytes are recoverable from hash-verified sources, extend the twice-proven .gitattributes -text -whitespace rule to tools/science_funnel/data/wiseman2026/**, and re-canonicalize the pin (route b) ONLY for files whose original bytes are provably unrecoverable - then a TRUE fresh clone in BOTH autocrlf flavors must sha256-verify every manifest-covered committed file, and the downstream osim4 adapter (bbbc4d67) must reproduce its committed artifacts byte-exact and pass 12/12 tests against the repaired bytes.
rule0.prediction: 16 manifest-covered files are committed; 13 blobs diverge from their pins (12 by pure CRLF-stripping: delta == blob LF count; 1 mixed-EOL file inventory.json: delta 3387 = its original CRLF count, blob LF count 3848 = 3387 CRLF + 461 bare LF); 4 blobs (acquisition_preregistration.json, 2 SIs, and after amendment inventory.json) already match or will match their canonical bytes; after the fix, both autocrlf flavors verify 16/16 manifest-covered files, worktree==blob holds 7/7 .osim by hash-object==rev-parse, the adapter's canonical Macaque parse digest reproduces fcc119b953cf93d957760770e3d24884f79f9db14396e7f12b7ec4ec7857f792, its three committed JSON artifacts regenerate byte-identical, and its tests pass 12/12.

route_b_recanonicalize_pin.why_route_b_only_here: inventory.json is DERIVED lane metadata (schema chimera.wiseman2026_inventory.v1), not upstream deposit content - the upstream provenance chain lives in the zip/SI/_api/receipt pins, all restored by route (a); its original bytes are unrecoverable with evidence: (1) the generator was never committed (git show aede5de9 carries no script; the lane worktree has no .py referencing inventory.json; git status clean), (2) the lane worktree copy was re-smudged by a later checkout (71002 B, sha != pin; the original mixed-EOL file had 3387 CRLF + 461 bare LF and the LF-normalized blob cannot be uniquely re-mixed - sha256 is not invertible and Rule 1 forbids guessing which lines carried CR), (3) the zip contains only upstream artifacts, not this derived file; the committed LF blob's CONTENT is exactly what every adapter consumer has parsed since aede5de9 (validated by falsifiers F4/F5), so canonicalizing the pin to it documents reality instead of inventing history
